migrations.fence_rationale: The maintenance freeze is advisory: it lives in meta rows that a clone which never pulled does not read, so a stale clone writes straight through a live freeze and its writes are destroyed by restore-legacy --replace. Moving SCHEMA_VERSION is the only enforcement that reaches such a clone. There was no schema delta to attach the bump to, and inventing DDL purely to justify the number would have been worse.
migrations.summary: Write fence against stale clones; carries no DDL
migrations.deployment_order: Fence code must ship BEFORE the cutover freeze is taken: a clone that pulls after the freeze starts can neither read nor migrate until the freeze lifts.
